**Analysis summary:**

- **Test image**: White, powdery circular patches on the upper surface of green tomato leaves — discrete round white spots scattered across multiple leaves
- **Powdery Mildew reference**: Matches exactly — white powdery sporulation in round spots on leaf surfaces
- **Early Blight**: Brown concentric-ring lesions with yellow halos — not present
- **Septoria Leaf Spot**: Small dark spots with dark borders — not present
- **Spider Mites**: Stippling, yellowing, webbing — not present
- **Target Spot**: Pitted dark lesions with rings — not present
- **Leaf Mold**: Pale yellow upper spots with olive mold below — not present

The white chalky/powdery circular spots on the upper leaf surface are the hallmark of Powdery Mildew with no competing features from other classes.
